study_model: Separate Qwen3-4B checkpoint, whose same-context fit must be checked before a model probe
prefix_rule: Inspect only assertions completed wholly before the smaller of 12000 Unicode characters and the exact thinking-text length. This is a screening window, not a teacher-forced training truncation or a native-token claim. Keep source sequences intact for eligibility and abstain on unclear spans.
lexical_triage: Case-insensitive whole-word wait, actually, mistake, error, incorrect, wrong, correction, contradiction, recalculate, double-check. Triage has no mathematical authority and absence of a lexical hit never proves C.
E: An already asserted local state demonstrably wrong under the original task is explicitly replaced by a sound same-object value or relation. A later completed, independently verifiable first affected consequence must use the replacement to certify E with propagation. A sound replacement without this consequence is E_REPAIR_ONLY.
W: A previously sound scoped assertion is followed by a distinct proposed replacement that is independently refuted under the same premise and target. Keep rejection, acceptance and unresolved proposal outcomes separate. A self-check, quotation or uncommitted trial without a specific replacement remains unknown.
C: A sound original local assertion is actively used in a later completed derivation with same meaning, intact premises and independent exact local evidence. No revision of that state is present between the named anchors. Lack of an observable correction is insufficient.
comparison_boundary: An archive span or scope label does not create a comparable counterfactual continuation. Any edited pair is separately controlled, with same visible prefix, semantic granularity, answer-copy checks and student tokenizer length check. No native continuations or EOS claims from this file.
evidence_required: Exact case and sample identity, assertion half-open Unicode offsets and UTF-8 digest, complete readout end, digest of observed prefix, explicit original object and assumptions, and independently reproducible mathematical check. Unreviewed, ambiguous and impossible-to-certify remain UNKNOWN.
blindness: Read publisher-separated thinking text only. No final response content, gold, answer, parsed answer, correctness, or old AIME draws 8–15. Public artifacts contain no raw statements or trajectories. Read and freeze each role before using the later outcome.
